# HTTP API and event stream

The web console's server (`src/web/server.py`), from the OpenAPI document (`frontend/openapi.json`, itself checked against the code by `tests/test_api_contract.py`). Every `/api/*` route except `/api/health` needs the per-launch token as `Authorization: Bearer`; state-changing requests must come from the console's own origin.

| Method | Path | Query | Body | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/ai/calibration` | - | - | CalibrationView | Ai Calibration |
| GET | `/api/ai/calls` | role, book, date, limit | - | list[LLMCallRow] | Ai Calls |
| GET | `/api/ai/decision-models` | date | - | list[DecisionModelStats] | Ai Decision Models |
| GET | `/api/ai/models` | - | - | list[RoleModels] | Ai Models |
| GET | `/api/ai/spend` | group_by, since, until | - | SpendView | Ai Spend |
| GET | `/api/alerts` | level, date, limit | - | list[AlertRow] | Alerts |
| GET | `/api/books` | - | - | BooksView | Books |
| GET | `/api/config` | - | - | ConfigView | Config |
| GET | `/api/decisions` | book, symbol, strategy, outcome, date, limit | - | list[DecisionRow] | Decisions |
| GET | `/api/decisions/{decision_id}` | - | - | Lineage | Decision |
| GET | `/api/docs/preregistration` | - | - | Document | Preregistration |
| GET | `/api/equity` | - | - | EquityView | Equity |
| GET | `/api/events/typed` | symbol, date, limit | - | list[TypedEventRow] | Typed Events |
| GET | `/api/fills` | book, date, symbol, limit | - | list[FillRow] | Fills |
| GET | `/api/health` | - | - | object | Health |
| GET | `/api/logs` | level, contains, limit | - | list[LogLine] | Logs |
| GET | `/api/market/watchlist` | - | - | list[WatchRow] | Watchlist |
| GET | `/api/market/{symbol}/bars` | days, adjusted | - | Bars | Bars |
| GET | `/api/orders` | book, status, date, symbol, limit | - | list[OrderRow] | Orders |
| GET | `/api/positions` | book | - | list[PositionRow] | Positions |
| GET | `/api/reports` | limit | - | list[ReportSummary] | Reports |
| GET | `/api/reports/{day}` | - | - | object | Report |
| GET | `/api/reports/{day}/markdown` | - | - | Document | Report Markdown |
| GET | `/api/risk` | book | - | RiskView | Risk |
| POST | `/api/risk/flatten` | - | FlattenBody | ControlResult | Risk Flatten |
| POST | `/api/risk/halt` | - | HaltBody | ControlResult | Block new entries. Allowed even in read-only mode (stopping risk is always OK). |
| POST | `/api/risk/resume` | - | ResumeBody | ControlResult | Risk Resume |
| POST | `/api/session/start` | - | - | ControlResult | Session Start |
| POST | `/api/session/stop` | - | - | ControlResult | Cooperative: the engine finishes the step it is in; cancelled only after 30 s. |
| GET | `/api/summary` | - | - | Summary | Summary |
| GET | `/api/system` | - | - | SystemView | System |
| GET | `/api/trades` | book, date, strategy, symbol, limit | - | list[TradeRow] | Trades |

## WebSocket stream (`/ws`)

Token as the `rq.token.<token>` subprotocol (the server answers `rq.v1`). Send `{"subscribe": [topics], "since_seq": n}`: stored events after `n` are replayed, then new ones follow, none lost or repeated; `events` subscribes to every event topic. Slots are latest-wins values, not queued.

| Topic | Kind | Carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ai` | events | BudgetThresholdCrossed, DecisionModelCall, LLMCall, TradeReview |
| `decisions` | events | AdvisorFallback, AdvisorRequested, AdvisorVerdict, OrderIntentProposed, RiskDecision, ShadowAlphaSettled, ShadowTradeClosed, ShadowTradeOpened, SignalDisposition, SignalGenerated |
| `market` | events | AnnouncementCoverageGap, AnnouncementReceived, BarClosed, DataSourceChanged, FeedRecovered, FeedStale, QuoteReceived, QuoteRejected, RegimeComputed, TypedEvent |
| `orders` | events | FillReceived, OrderAcked, OrderCancelled, OrderExpired, OrderRejected, OrderSubmitted, OrderUnknown |
| `positions` | events | MarkToMarket, PositionChanged, TradeClosed |
| `risk` | events | ControlCommand, DailyRiskStateRolled, KillSwitchChanged, LimitBreached, ReconciliationResult |
| `system` | events | Alert, Heartbeat, HolidaySkipped, LoopLag, ProcessStarted, ProcessStopped, SessionStateChanged |
| `quotes` | slot | the latest quotes, at most 1 Hz |
| `summary` | slot | the console summary, every second |
